displayPattern: 7-segment display on a *CVC96 or *MVC96 two-stage furnace covered by IOG-2015L, including Amana AMVC96 and ACVC96: EE4. The induced draft blower and circulator blower run continuously and the furnace does not operate
meaning: Flame was sensed with no call for heat.
causes: Short to ground in the flame sense circuit
diySteps: If you smell gas, leave and call the gas supplier from outside
Technician: correct a short at the flame sensor or in the flame sensor wiring, and check for a lingering or lazy flame and gas valve operation
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. EE4 means the control sees flame when heat was not requested.
sourceTitle: Amana and Goodman *CVC96 / *MVC96 two-stage furnace installation instructions (IOG-2015L)
